speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me. I understand you are presenting with rectal bleeding and a palpable rectal mass. To determine the nature of this mass, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as narrower stools or a feeling of incomplete evacuation?

speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Carcinoma. The combination of a palpable rectal mass and daily rectal bleeding in a 45-year-old female is highly suspicious for malignancy. I recommend proceeding immediately with a digital rectal examination and a colonoscopy with biopsy to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Colonoscopy with Biopsy.
